payload.title: Reject orders when there isn't enough stock. Before placing an order, check availability with the inventory team's Stock API: GET https://stock.inventory.internal/v1/stock/{sku} returns { "sku": string, "available": number }. If any line asks for more than is available, POST /orders must return 409.

payload.content:
Implemented stock validation for order placement.

- `POST /orders` calls Inventory Stock API before payment; insufficient stock returns `409 insufficient_stock`.
- Duplicate SKU quantities are aggregated before checking availability.
- Stock checks are injectable via `stockGateway`; production uses the new HTTP adapter.
- Inventory failures return 502 and do not place or publish an order.

Verified with `npm test` (43 passing), `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run arch`.
